notes: Label for the selected utility rate in the OpenEI utility rate database.

notes: The import power limit from the utility in megawatts

notes: The export power limit to the utility in megawatts

notes: A price in $/ton of CO2 emissions that the controller uses to dispatch the energy storage systems.

notes: A price in $/kWh that the utility will pay customers for net electrical energy production at the end of the yearly true up period.

name: Analysis Name
notes: Input Field for what to name the analysis.

name: Project Life
notes: The projected project life in years.

name: Discout Rate
notes: The rate to discount future financial costs.

notes: Input Field for opening a results file.
